name: Schengen Short-Stay Visa (C-visa)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires sufficient financial means for the stay, calculated at EUR 70 per day, plus proof of accommodation and a return/onward travel plan.
requirements.fix_path: Document at least EUR 70/day in available funds for the stay.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires travel medical insurance with coverage of at least EUR 30,000, valid for the whole Schengen area for the full stay.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase qualifying travel medical insurance before applying.

evidence_required.document: Passport (issued within 10 years, valid 3+ months beyond departure, 2+ blank pages)
Proof of purpose of travel and accommodation

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days within any 180-day period; can be issued single- or multiple-entry, with visa validity up to 5 years

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Estonia (vm.ee) -- Application for a Schengen visa

notes: FIRST ESTONIA ROUTE, part of this country's initial build. This models the short-stay (C-visa) Schengen route specifically for Estonia as the responsible consulate; the underlying legal framework is EU-wide (Visa Code), which is why this is thinner than a fully national route -- consistent with how other Schengen-member countries in this dataset handle their own schengen_visitor routes. Processing: applications submitted 15 days to 6 months before travel, decisions typically in 15 days (up to 45 for complex cases). Nationals of many countries do not need a visa at all for short stays; this route applies only to nationals who do.
